title.zh: vLLM 推理工程

subtitle.zh: 10 天，跟着实验做出第一份推理工程作品
subtitle.en: Build your first inference engineering portfolio in 10 guided days

description.zh: 从可运行的本机模拟服务出发，逐步掌握请求、指标、缓存、参数实验和排错；有兼容 GPU 时接入固定版本 vLLM 实测。每天提供图解、代码、操作步骤、结果对照与测验，最后交付可复查的工程报告。
description.en: Start with a runnable local mock, then learn requests, metrics, caching, controlled tuning and debugging. With a compatible GPU, connect the same tools to a pinned vLLM service. Each day has diagrams, code, instructions, expected results and quizzes, ending with an auditable report.

hoursPerDay.en: 120–150 minutes a day; about 20–25 hours total

prerequisites.zh: 完成系统基础；会运行 Python 文件、读列表/字典与 JSON。GPU 路线另需 Linux 终端与虚拟环境基础。第一天先跑 CPU 自检，不要求先买 GPU。
prerequisites.en: Complete foundations; run Python scripts and read lists, dictionaries and JSON. The GPU route also needs Linux terminal and virtual-environment skills. Begin with the CPU self-check; no GPU purchase is required.

hardware.zh: CPU 路径：Python 3.9+ 标准库，普通电脑即可；GPU 路径：Linux x86_64、Python 3.12、vLLM 0.33.0、兼容 NVIDIA GPU（本示例建议空闲 8 GiB 以上，容量建议非保证）及匹配 CUDA 的驱动。GPU 命令已对照官方资料，尚未由本站真机验证；模拟不会运行模型。
hardware.en: CPU route: Python 3.9+ standard library on a laptop. GPU route: Linux x86_64, Python 3.12, vLLM 0.33.0, a compatible NVIDIA GPU (8 GiB or more free is a teaching budget, not a guarantee), and a matching CUDA driver. GPU commands were checked against official sources but not executed on GPU by this site. The simulator runs no model.

zh: 推理引擎工程师
LLM Serving 工程师

en: Inference engine engineer

outcome.zh: 一个带原始 JSONL、汇总 CSV、实验配置、校验脚本和技术复盘的作品目录。CPU 作品标注 simulated/design；只有真实 vLLM 运行记录才标 measured。
outcome.en: A portfolio directory with raw JSONL, summary CSV, experiment settings, validation and a technical review. Label CPU work simulated/design; reserve measured for actual vLLM runs.

title.zh: 锁定环境与最小可运行模型
title.en: Pin the environment and a minimal model

lesson.zh: 先把“客户端能收到响应”和“模型在 GPU 上计算”分开。今天先用 Python 模拟服务确认工作目录、请求格式与输出文件都正确，再选择 GPU 路线。模拟返回固定文字，不加载权重；因此它能验证客户端，却不能证明 vLLM 的性能。安装版本、模型 revision 和启动参数要一起记录，否则同一条命令以后可能运行出不同的软件组合。
lesson.en: Separate receiving a response from running model computation on a GPU. First use the Python mock to verify your directory, request format and output files; then choose the GPU route. The mock returns fixed text and loads no weights, so it tests the client without establishing vLLM performance. Record the package version, model revision and launch settings together.

task.en: Follow the steps below: predict, run, then record actual output, one code/parameter change and one remaining question.

evidence.en: Day 1 notes, corresponding out/ artifacts, two explained quiz answers and your change/observation; consolidate into REPORT.md on day 10.

noGpu.en: Complete today’s CPU commands. Label mock/virtual-time data simulated and capacity/deployment plans design. Defer GPU-only steps without marking them measured.

title.zh: 今天的两条路线

body.zh: CPU 路线只使用 Python 标准库；所有实验数据必须写 simulated。GPU 路线选 Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct，固定 revision 7ae557604adf67be50417f59c2c2f167def9a775。权重约 1 GB，但运行时还有缓存、激活和框架开销，不能按权重大小挑显存。
body.en: The CPU route only uses the standard library and labels data simulated. The GPU route pins Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct to revision 7ae557604adf67be50417f59c2c2f167def9a775. Roughly 1 GB of weights is only part of the memory requirement: cache, activations and runtime also need space.

title.zh: 先判断环境，再安装

body.zh: GPU 示例面向 Linux NVIDIA：官方 0.33.0 要求计算能力至少 7.5；这里使用 Python 3.12 独立环境。先看 nvidia-smi，驱动必须兼容所安装 wheel 的 CUDA；官方 CUDA 13 镜像常规运行要求 R580 或更新。Mac 和不兼容设备先走 CPU 路线。本站未在 GPU 执行下面的命令，不把资料核对写成实测通过。
body.en: The NVIDIA example targets Linux; version 0.33.0 lists compute capability 7.5 or above. Use a separate Python 3.12 environment and inspect nvidia-smi first. The driver must support the wheel CUDA runtime; official CUDA 13 images normally require R580 or newer. Use the CPU route on incompatible devices. The following GPU commands have not been GPU-tested by this site.

title.zh: 从命令到可检查的结果

caption.zh: 绿色路线是接口练习；换成 vLLM 后才包含模型推理。
caption.en: The mock route practices the interface; model inference occurs only after switching to vLLM.

title.zh: 下载、解压、自检

body.zh: 点击本页实验包，解压得到 vllm 文件夹。在终端进入该文件夹；以下所有天数都从这里运行。Windows CPU 路线可把 python3 换成 py -3。
body.en: Download this page’s lab ZIP and unzip the vllm folder. Run every day from inside it. On Windows, replace python3 with py -3 for the CPU route.

walkthrough.command:
cd vllm
python3 lab.py selfcheck
python3 lab.py env

expected.zh: 显示 PASS；out/environment.json 记录 Python 和包版本。vllm=not installed 对 CPU 路线正常。
expected.en: PASS appears; out/environment.json records Python and packages. vllm=not installed is normal on the CPU route.

title.zh: CPU 终端 A：启动并保持服务
title.en: CPU terminal A: start and keep the service running

body.zh: 从 vllm 目录运行下面一条命令。终端会一直被服务占用，这是正常现象；保持它运行，另开终端 B 完成下一步。需要结束时在终端 A 按 Ctrl+C。
body.en: Run this one command from the vllm directory. The terminal remains occupied by the server; this is expected. Leave it running and open terminal B for the next step. Ctrl+C in A stops it.

expected.zh: 看到 SIMULATED 与 127.0.0.1:8000。此终端暂时不会返回命令提示符。
expected.en: SIMULATED and 127.0.0.1:8000 appear. This terminal does not return to its prompt yet.

walkthrough.command: python3 lab.py mock

title.zh: CPU 终端 B：发送首个请求
title.en: CPU terminal B: send the first request

body.zh: 新开一个终端，进入刚才解压出来的 vllm 文件夹（与终端 A 相同的目录），再执行下面命令。不要在仍运行服务的终端 A 粘贴。
body.en: Open a new terminal and enter the same extracted vllm folder as terminal A. Run the command here, not in the occupied server terminal.

expected.zh: summary 中 ok=1；requests.jsonl 的 response 为 MOCK OK、evidence 为 simulated。之后 CPU 练习继续保留终端 A 的 mock。
expected.en: Summary shows ok=1; requests.jsonl contains MOCK OK and evidence simulated. Keep the mock in A running for subsequent CPU exercises.

walkthrough.command: python3 lab.py request --out out/first

title.zh: GPU 可选：准备独立环境
title.en: Optional GPU: prepare a separate environment

body.zh: 仅在符合上方硬件要求的 Linux GPU 机器执行。进入解压后的 vllm 目录，安装固定版本并检查将要运行的命令。下面尚未启动服务；CPU 学习者跳过全部 GPU 可选步骤。
body.en: Run only on a Linux GPU machine meeting the requirements above. Enter the extracted vllm directory, install the pinned version and inspect the launch command. This step does not start the server. CPU learners skip GPU-only steps.

expected.zh: 输出完整启动命令并返回命令提示符；out/ 内保存环境和依赖记录。
expected.en: The complete launch command is printed and the prompt returns. Environment and dependency records are saved in out/.

walkthrough.command:
nvidia-smi
python3.12 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install "vllm==0.33.0"
python lab.py env
python -m pip freeze > out/requirements.lock.txt
python serve.py --dry-run

title.zh: GPU 终端 A：启动真实服务
title.en: GPU terminal A: start the real service

body.zh: 在刚才激活环境的终端启动。它固定模型/tokenizer revision、1024 上下文、4 个序列、FP16、50% 显存预算和 eager 模式，监听 8001。等待下载、编译及就绪日志，保持终端运行；后续命令在新终端 B 执行。
body.en: Start from the activated environment. The launcher pins model/tokenizer revision, 1024 context, 4 sequences, FP16, 50% memory budget and eager mode on port 8001. Wait through download/compilation for readiness. Keep this terminal running and use a new terminal B for requests.

expected.zh: 服务日志显示启动成功。当前终端被服务占用属于正常情况，不继续在这里粘贴客户端命令。
expected.en: Server logs show successful startup. The occupied terminal is expected; do not paste client commands here.

walkthrough.command: python serve.py --cache off

title.zh: GPU 终端 B：激活环境并请求
title.en: GPU terminal B: activate the environment and request

body.zh: 打开第二个 GPU 终端，进入同一个 vllm 目录，然后执行下面命令。真实 GPU 使用 8001；CPU mock 使用 8000，二者不能混用。本站没有执行真机验证，以你的实际运行记录验收。
body.en: Open a second GPU terminal and enter the same vllm directory, then run these commands. Real GPU uses 8001; the CPU mock uses 8000. This site has not GPU-tested the instructions; validate using your own run records.

expected.zh: 客户端 ok=1；模型文字可变，以 JSON 结构和状态验收。没有成功运行就保留错误，不填写实测通过。
expected.en: The client reports ok=1. Model wording can vary; validate JSON structure/status. Preserve failures instead of claiming a successful measurement.

walkthrough.command:
source .venv/bin/activate
python lab.py request --port 8001 --model Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct --evidence measured --out out/gpu-first

symptom.zh: 找不到 lab.py

fix.zh: 终端必须位于解压后的 vllm 文件夹。用 pwd（Windows 用 cd）查看目录，再列出 lab.py。
fix.en: Enter the extracted vllm folder. Check pwd (cd on Windows) and confirm lab.py exists.

symptom.zh: Connection refused / CUDA 显存或驱动错误
symptom.en: Connection refused / CUDA memory or driver error

fix.zh: 先确认 mock 8000 或 GPU 8001 服务仍在运行。GPU 出错先保存日志；检查驱动兼容性及空闲显存，尝试 python serve.py --context 512 --sequences 1。仍失败就完成 CPU 路线，保留失败说明。
fix.en: Confirm the mock on 8000 or GPU service on 8001 is running. Preserve GPU logs, check driver compatibility/free memory, and try python serve.py --context 512 --sequences 1. If still blocked, complete the CPU route and record the failure.

question.zh: mock 返回 MOCK OK，证明了什么？
question.en: What does MOCK OK establish?

options.zh: 客户端能访问本机模拟接口
options.en: The client reached the local mock API

options.zh: vLLM 已完成 GPU 推理

explanation.zh: mock 没有模型或 tokenizer，只能验证请求和响应路径。
explanation.en: The mock has no model or tokenizer; it validates the request/response path.

question.zh: 复现 GPU 实验至少要固定什么？
question.en: What must a reproducible GPU run pin?

options.zh: 框架版本、模型 revision、完整启动参数
options.en: Framework version, model revision and launch settings

options.zh: 只记录 GPU 利用率

explanation.zh: 同名模型、默认参数和软件版本都可能变化；硬件和负载也要记录。
explanation.en: Model revisions, defaults and software can change; hardware and workload must also be recorded.

title.zh: 把服务变成可测试的 API
title.en: Make the service a testable API

lesson.zh: 服务可用不仅是收到一段文本。客户端要知道模型名、聊天模板、采样参数、超时和错误格式；流式输出还需要区分连接建立、首 token 和结束事件。接口兼容也不表示所有扩展参数的行为完全相同。先固定请求内容与模板，建立成功与失败的测试集，再把 API 接到应用中，能避免把格式错误误判成推理性能问题。
lesson.en: A usable service is more than a text response. Clients need the model name, chat template, sampling parameters, timeouts and error handling. Streaming requires separate connection, first-token and completion events. API compatibility does not imply identical behavior for every extension. Fix request content and templates, then build success and failure cases before integrating an application. This prevents request-format errors from being mistaken for performance problems.

title.zh: 一次响应有多个时间点

body.zh: 从发送请求到完整响应是端到端延迟；流式接口能更早收到片段。脚本记录首个非空 content 事件，它可能包含多个 token，因此这里叫 first_content_latency_ms，不直接命名 TTFT。非流式请求没有这个时间点，应保留 null，不能把完整响应耗时当首 token 延迟。
body.en: End-to-end latency runs from sending to completion. Streaming can expose content earlier. The client times the first non-empty content event, which may contain several tokens, so it calls the field first_content_latency_ms rather than TTFT. Non-streaming requests leave it null.

title.zh: 让错误成为数据
title.en: Make errors part of the data

body.zh: 成功、HTTP 错误和超时都要有 request_id。404 常表示模型名或路径错误；超时表示客户端等待预算耗尽，不代表服务器必然停止了计算。模拟器提供显式注入标记，方便在自己的本机练习恢复步骤。
body.en: Every success, HTTP error and timeout needs a request ID. A 404 often indicates the model name or path. A timeout means the client exhausted its wait budget, not necessarily that server computation stopped. The mock provides explicit fault markers for local practice.

title.zh: 流式响应时间线

caption.zh: 客户端只能看到外部时间；无法仅从这条时间线分离真实排队和计算耗时。
caption.en: Client timing alone cannot separate real queueing and computation.

title.zh: 先确认 CPU mock 正在运行
title.en: First confirm the CPU mock is running

Skip it if already running to avoid a port conflict. Use client terminal B in the same directory for following commands. GPU port 8001 does not answer default port-8000 requests; fault injection works only on the mock.

title.zh: 比较流式与非流式

body.zh: 保留第一天 mock 服务。读取两个目录的 requests.jsonl，比较 first_content_latency_ms 与 latency_ms。

python3 lab.py request --out out/plain
python3 lab.py request --stream --out out/stream

expected.zh: 两次都成功；plain 的首内容时间为 null，stream 为非负数，且不大于完整响应耗时。
expected.en: Both succeed. The plain first-content time is null; the streaming value is nonnegative and no larger than end-to-end latency.

title.zh: 复现错误和超时

body.zh: 这些注入标记只对教学 mock 生效，不发送到真实模型来模拟故障。每次使用独立输出目录。
body.en: Fault markers work only on the teaching mock. Do not send them to a real model as a fault simulator. Keep separate output directories.

python3 lab.py request --prompt INJECT_ERROR --out out/error

expected.en: Results are error/404, error/500 and timeout. With no successful samples, latency percentiles and token throughput remain null.

title.zh: 自己的修改

body.zh: 阅读 request_one，找到开始、首内容、结束三个时间点。修改提示词，再用 GPU 服务（如已有）运行相同客户端；证据类型要分别保存。

walkthrough.command: python3 lab.py request --stream --prompt "Explain a queue in one sentence." --out out/my-request

expected.zh: 保存一条请求并在笔记中说明为什么首内容时间不是总延迟。
expected.en: Save the request and explain why first-content latency differs from total latency.

symptom.zh: 流式首内容时间为空

fix.zh: 检查 status、响应类型和 choices.delta.content；错误响应或没有内容的事件不会产生这个指标。
fix.en: Check status, response type and choices.delta.content; errors or content-free events do not produce it.

symptom.zh: 超时后误以为服务已停止

fix.zh: 再发一次正常请求；客户端超时和服务进程存活是两件事。不要把失败请求从结果分母删除。
fix.en: Send a normal request again. Client timeout and server liveness are separate; retain failures in the denominator.

question.zh: 非流式响应耗时 1 秒，可以直接说 TTFT=1 秒吗？
question.en: Can a 1-second non-streaming response establish TTFT=1s?

options.zh: 不可以，没有观测首 token
options.en: No, the first token was not observed

explanation.zh: 一次返回完整响应，不能知道生成第一个 token 的时刻。
explanation.en: A complete response does not expose when the first token was generated.

question.zh: 12 个请求中 2 个超时，成功率的分母是多少？
question.en: With 12 requests and 2 timeouts, what is the success-rate denominator?

explanation.zh: 所有已发出的请求都进入分母；失败不能静默消失。
explanation.en: All submitted requests belong in the denominator.

title.zh: 读懂调度器与 KV cache 的关系

lesson.zh: 请求进入系统后，调度器决定何时处理哪些 token，执行层负责完成模型计算。KV cache 为在途序列保存状态，它的容量会限制能够同时推进的工作；块式管理减少了对连续大块空间的依赖，但并不会消除所有内存约束。阅读源码时应固定 commit，跟踪请求对象、调度输出和缓存分配之间的关系，避免背诵过期的类名。
lesson.en: After admission, the scheduler decides which tokens to process and the execution layer performs model computation. KV cache holds state for in-flight sequences, limiting the work that can advance concurrently. Block-based management reduces dependence on large contiguous allocations but does not remove every memory constraint. Pin a commit and trace request objects, scheduler outputs and cache allocation rather than memorizing class names that may change between versions.

body.zh: 对本课 Qwen2.5-0.5B 的普通全注意力 KV 估算：字节数=2（K/V）×24 层×2 个 KV heads×64 head dimension×2 字节×token 数×序列数。1024 token、1 序列得到 12 MiB；4 序列是 48 MiB。这里用 KV heads，不是 14 个 query heads。

title.zh: 缓存大小与调度的联系

body.zh: 每个活跃序列都需要状态；长上下文与更多并发会占用更多缓存。调度器决定哪些 token 前进，执行器负责计算，缓存管理负责可用块。公式不包含权重、激活、块填充和运行时开销，所以不能直接把总显存除以公式结果当最大并发。
body.en: Active sequences need state; longer contexts and more concurrent sequences consume more cache. The scheduler selects work, the executor computes, and cache management tracks available blocks. The formula excludes weights, activations, padding and runtime overhead, so it cannot directly predict maximum concurrency.

title.en: Establish a baseline instead of chasing a peak

lesson.en: Online inference performance depends on the workload. Short-input long-output, long-input short-output and bursty requests stress different parts of the system. Before comparing settings, fix lengths, arrivals, model and sampling parameters. Report latency, throughput, success rate and completed request count together. A small repeated baseline provides evidence for later changes; a single peak number cannot tell you whether an optimization improves the intended workload.

title.zh: 验证前缀缓存什么时候有用

lesson.zh: 前缀缓存通过复用相同前缀的历史状态来减少重复 prefill，不会自动减少生成所有新 token 的工作量。命中条件受 token 序列和模型语义约束，冷缓存与热缓存必须分开。即使前缀重合较多，短提示、传输成本或工作负载变化也可能削弱收益。实验需要证明所见差异来自缓存，而不是输入长度或预热程度发生变化。
lesson.en: Prefix caching reuses historical state for matching prefixes, reducing repeated prefill work rather than eliminating generation of new tokens. Reuse depends on token sequences and model semantics, and cold and warm states must be separated. Short prompts, overhead or changing workloads can reduce the benefit. An experiment should establish that differences come from caching, not changed prompt lengths or inconsistent warm-up conditions.

title.zh: 复用的是前缀状态

body.zh: 前缀缓存减少已处理输入的重复计算；新生成 token 的工作仍然存在。玩具模型把命中后的 prefill 从 40ms 改成 10ms，decode 每 token 仍为 5ms。第一次共享请求必须先完成，后续请求才可能使用缓存；并发尚未完成的请求不算命中。
body.en: Prefix reuse saves repeated input computation; generating new output remains. The toy changes hit prefill from 40ms to 10ms while decoding stays at 5ms per later token. The first shared request must complete before subsequent requests can reuse its cache.

title.zh: 冷态、热态和关闭缓存

body.zh: 关闭缓存提供对照；开启冷缓存时第一次请求还没有可复用状态；热缓存需要明确记录预热请求。真实 vLLM 的命中取决于实际 token 前缀与块管理，字符串看起来相同并不代替 tokenizer 检查。缓存也可能被容量压力驱逐。
body.en: Disabled caching is the control. Enabled-cold has no reusable state for its first request; warm measurements require recorded warm-up requests. Real vLLM reuse depends on token prefixes and block management, and capacity pressure can evict state.

lesson.zh: 并发、上下文上限和每次调度的 token 预算会共同影响内存占用、排队和延迟。参数更大不等于性能更好：过多在途工作可能推高尾延迟，内存压力也可能带来额外调度代价。先画出需要比较的参数矩阵，每次只改一个变量，从可运行的小配置开始，保留失败条件，而不是只展示成功组合。
lesson.en: Concurrency, context limits and scheduled-token budgets interact with memory, queuing and latency. Larger settings are not automatically better: more in-flight work can raise tail latency, and memory pressure can add scheduling costs. Define the comparison matrix first, change one variable at a time and start from a small working configuration. Preserve failed conditions as evidence instead of displaying only successful combinations.

title.zh: 用数值小实验理解量化取舍
title.en: Understand quantization with a numerical experiment

lesson.zh: 量化可能减少权重或缓存的存储量，但权重量化和 KV cache 量化解决的是不同成本。支持的格式、算子和硬件会随版本变化，较少的位数也不保证更快，因为数据转换与内核实现同样重要。评估时要固定任务与模型来源，分别检查内存、延迟和任务质量；只比较生成文本是否一模一样不是充分的质量判断。
lesson.en: Quantization can reduce weight or cache storage, but weight quantization and KV-cache quantization address different costs. Supported formats, kernels and hardware vary by release. Fewer bits do not guarantee lower latency because conversion overhead and kernel implementation matter. Keep task and model provenance fixed while assessing memory, latency and task quality separately. Exact equality between generated texts is not a sufficient quality evaluation.

title.zh: 选择合适的并行扩展方式

lesson.zh: 张量并行把一次模型计算分给多设备，数据并行用多个副本处理不同请求；两者需要不同的内存和通信预算。能在单卡装下的模型未必适合增加张量并行，跨设备通信可能抵消计算收益。多机部署还引入网络拓扑、路由和故障边界。先明确是容量不足、吞吐不足还是延迟目标未达成，再选择扩展方式。
lesson.en: Tensor parallelism splits model computation across devices, while data parallelism uses replicas for different requests. They have different memory and communication costs. A model that fits on one device may gain little from extra tensor parallelism if communication offsets the compute benefit. Multi-node setups add networking, routing and failure boundaries. Identify whether the problem is capacity, throughput or latency before selecting a scaling strategy.

title.zh: 为服务建立观测和故障手册

lesson.zh: 用户看到请求失败时，原因可能在输入校验、排队、模型执行、输出传输或客户端超时。可观测性要能把症状映射到可能的组件，而不是只画 GPU 利用率。指标名称与标签会随 release 调整，应从实际端点核对。故障手册需要包含先检查什么、怎样回到已知可用配置，以及哪些证据足以支持或否定假设。
lesson.en: A failed request may originate in validation, queuing, model execution, response transport or client timeout. Observability should map symptoms to likely components rather than showing only GPU utilization. Metric names and labels can change, so verify them against the running release. A runbook should explain what to inspect first, how to return to a known working configuration and what evidence supports or refutes each hypothesis.

evidence.zh: Day 9 笔记、对应 out/ 实验文件、两道测验解析，以及本人修改与观察；第 10 天汇总为 REPORT.md。
evidence.en: Day 9 notes, corresponding out/ artifacts, two explained quiz answers and your change/observation; consolidate into REPORT.md on day 10.

zh: 能够解释当天图解中的输入、处理和输出
保存实际运行结果，区分模拟、设计和GPU实测
完成独立修改并解释至少一个错误/局限
en: Explain the diagram’s inputs, processing and outputs
Save actual results and distinguish simulation, design and GPU measurement
Complete an independent change and explain an error or limitation

noGpu.zh: 本日 CPU 命令可以完成；mock/虚拟时间结果标 simulated，容量和部署方案标 design。仅 GPU 可选步骤暂缓，不能把它们标记为已实测。
noGpu.en: Complete today’s CPU commands. Label mock/virtual-time data simulated and capacity/deployment plans design. Defer GPU-only steps without marking them measured.

title.zh: 按症状定位到一层

body.zh: 连接拒绝先看进程与端口；404 先看路径和模型名；400 看请求格式；超时看时间预算和负载；OOM 看容量。每次先保留错误和完整命令，再尝试一个恢复动作。不要一次修改全部配置，否则不知道哪一步解决了问题。
body.en: For connection refusal check process/port; for 404 check path/model; for 400 check format; for timeout inspect budget/load; for OOM inspect capacity. Preserve the error and command before trying one recovery action at a time.

title.zh: 故障不能从报表消失
title.en: Failures must remain in the report

body.zh: 模拟器显式制造一次 error 和一次 timeout，12 个请求中成功 10 个。成功延迟分位数不包含失败，但成功率分母仍是 12，吞吐的时间范围仍包括整轮。没有成功样本时显示 null 比显示 0ms 更诚实。
body.en: The simulator injects one error and one timeout, leaving 10 successes out of 12. Success latency percentiles exclude failures, but success rate retains all 12 and throughput uses whole-run time. With no successes, null is more informative than 0ms.

title.zh: 一次排错闭环

caption.zh: 恢复成功也要有正常请求证据，不以“进程还在”替代服务正确。
caption.en: A live process alone is insufficient; retain a successful recovery request.

title.zh: 先确认 CPU mock 正在运行
title.en: First confirm the CPU mock is running

body.zh: 本日默认 HTTP 命令访问 8000 端口的 CPU mock。若第 1 天的 mock 已停止，请在单独的服务终端 A、vllm 目录中运行下面命令并保持它运行；若已运行则跳过，避免重复占用端口。另一个客户端终端 B 进入同一 vllm 目录执行后续命令。8001 的 GPU 服务不会响应默认 8000 请求；故障注入仅对 mock 有效。
body.en: Today’s default HTTP commands target the CPU mock on port 8000. If the day-1 mock stopped, run the command below in a separate server terminal A inside vllm and leave it running. Skip it if already running to avoid a port conflict. Use client terminal B in the same directory for following commands. GPU port 8001 does not answer default port-8000 requests; fault injection works only on the mock.

expected.zh: 终端 A 显示 127.0.0.1:8000，随后保持服务；切到终端 B 执行后续步骤。
expected.en: Terminal A shows 127.0.0.1:8000 and stays occupied. Switch to terminal B for the following steps.

walkthrough.command: python3 lab.py mock

title.zh: 验收失败分母

body.zh: 无需服务器，生成明确注入的虚拟失败。查看 summary 并核对计数之和。
body.en: Generate deterministic injected failures without a server and verify count totals.

walkthrough.command:
python3 lab.py simulate --failures --out out/faults
python3 lab.py check out/faults

expected.zh: ok=10、error=1、timeout=1、total=12，验收 PASS。
expected.en: ok=10, error=1, timeout=1, total=12, and checks PASS.

title.zh: 本机演练恢复

body.zh: mock 运行时先注入错误再发正常请求。不要把 INJECT_ERROR 发送给 GPU 当作真实故障机制。
body.en: With the mock running, inject an error then send a normal request. INJECT_ERROR is not a real GPU failure mechanism.

walkthrough.command:
python3 lab.py request --prompt INJECT_ERROR --out out/broken
python3 lab.py request --out out/recovered

expected.zh: 前一次 error/500，后一次 ok；两个目录都保留。
expected.en: First error/500, then ok; retain both directories.

title.zh: 自己写三条排障记录

body.zh: 每条使用“症状→检查→动作→恢复判据”结构。至少覆盖连接拒绝、模型名错误和超时；注明哪些在 mock 验证、哪些 GPU 待验证。
body.en: Use symptom → check → action → recovery criterion for connection refusal, wrong model and timeout. Label mock-verified and GPU-unverified steps.

walkthrough.command: python3 lab.py check out/recovered

expected.zh: 正常请求记录能通过重算；笔记包含实际错误文本和恢复请求目录。
expected.en: The recovered request passes recomputation; notes include actual error text and recovery directory.

symptom.zh: 把失败请求删除后曲线更好看
symptom.en: Removing failures makes charts look better

fix.zh: 恢复原始请求集，分开报告成功延迟与全体成功率。图表必须带样本数。
fix.en: Restore all requests; report success latency separately from overall success rate and show sample counts.

symptom.zh: 持续重试导致更多超时

fix.zh: 先停止测试并降低并发，确认单请求能恢复；本课没有自动无限重试。
fix.en: Stop load and lower concurrency, then confirm one request works. This lab does not retry indefinitely.

question.zh: 12 个请求成功10个、错误1个、超时1个，成功率是多少？
question.en: With 10 successes, 1 error and 1 timeout out of 12, what is the success rate?

explanation.zh: 超时也是已提交请求，必须保留在分母。
explanation.en: Timeouts are submitted requests and stay in the denominator.

question.zh: 修改配置后进程还在，是否足以证明恢复？
question.en: Does a live process after a config change prove recovery?

options.zh: 不够，还需正常请求验证

explanation.zh: 存活和能够正确处理请求是不同状态。
explanation.en: Liveness and correct request handling are different states.

title.zh: 完成一个可审查的 vLLM 优化项目

lesson.zh: 最终作品应围绕一个具体问题：例如在固定工作负载下减少首 token 等待，或在指定延迟范围内提高完成请求数。用同一基准协议比较基线和一个改动，解释代价和失效条件。保留负面结果也有价值。工程能力体现在可复现的证据与判断，而不是宣传一个脱离硬件、版本和负载的通用加速倍数。
lesson.en: Center the capstone on one concrete problem, such as reducing first-token wait for a fixed workload or increasing completed requests within a latency target. Compare a baseline and one change using the same protocol, and explain costs and failure conditions. Negative results are useful too. Engineering judgment is demonstrated by reproducible evidence, not a universal speedup number detached from hardware, version and workload.

title.zh: 用证据回答一个小问题
title.en: Answer one small question with evidence

body.zh: 选一个边界明确的问题，例如“教学队列模型在固定输入下，增加独立 worker 如何影响等待？”或“我的 GPU 上重复前缀是否降低首内容等待？”报告必须把你的假设、一次改动、原始记录、反例和适用范围连起来。
body.en: Choose a bounded question: how independent workers affect waits in the fixed toy workload, or whether repeated prefixes reduce first-content delay on your GPU. Connect the hypothesis, one change, raw records, counterexample and scope.

title.zh: 自动报告是底稿，解释需要你写
title.en: The generated report is a scaffold

body.zh: report 会重算汇总并为原始文件生成 SHA-256 清单，帮助发现文件变化；它不能证明数据来自真实 GPU，也不能代替本人解释。保留 TODO 表示作品未完成，删掉 TODO 前必须写清本人修改和局限。
body.en: report recomputes the summary and hashes source files to expose later changes. Hashes do not prove GPU provenance or replace your explanation. A remaining TODO means the portfolio is unfinished; explain your own change and limitations before removing it.

title.zh: 把十天成果变成作品
title.en: Turn ten days into a portfolio

caption.zh: 结课不是官方认证；招聘方应能查看你的贡献和复现步骤。
caption.en: Completion is not official certification; reviewers should see your contribution and reproduction steps.

title.zh: 生成基线与改动报告

body.zh: 从一个干净输出目录重跑两组实验。CPU 路线使用下面缓存例子；GPU 路线使用自己的真实数据目录。
body.en: Rerun two conditions into clean output directories. CPU learners can use this cache example; GPU learners should use their measured directories.

walkthrough.command:
python3 lab.py simulate --out out/final-base
python3 lab.py simulate --cache --out out/final-change
python3 lab.py report out/final-base
python3 lab.py report out/final-change

expected.zh: 两个目录各有 REPORT.md 和 manifest.json，证据为 simulated。
expected.en: Each directory has REPORT.md and manifest.json with simulated evidence.

title.zh: 补齐本人的解释

body.zh: 阅读 README 的挑战和参考分析。填写 REPORT.md 中问题、本人改动、原始证据链接、一次失败或无收益结果、局限和下一实验。不要把示例模拟常数写成设备实测。
body.en: Read README challenges and reference analysis. Fill in the question, own change, evidence links, a failure/no-benefit case, limitations and next experiment. Never present toy constants as device measurements.

walkthrough.command:
python3 lab.py check out/final-base
python3 lab.py check out/final-change

expected.zh: 两次 PASS；报告没有未填写的 TODO，并且说明没有真实GPU时的证据边界。
expected.en: Both PASS; the report has no unanswered TODOs and explains evidence limits without a real GPU.

title.zh: 让另一个人从零复现
title.en: Ask someone to reproduce from scratch

body.zh: 分享代码、环境、运行命令和小样本，邀请同学复跑；尚未发生时写“未完成独立复现”。把作品链接整理进聘枢作品档案，不必公开个人敏感信息。
body.en: Share code, environment, commands and a small sample for a peer to reproduce. Until it happens, mark independent reproduction pending. Add the project link to your JobHub portfolio without private personal data.

walkthrough.command: python3 lab.py selfcheck

expected.zh: 同学能解释数据来源并重算汇总；记录实际复现日期/差异，未复现就如实标记。
expected.en: A peer can identify evidence sources and recompute metrics; record actual reproduction and differences or mark it pending.

symptom.zh: check 报 summary 不一致

fix.zh: 不要手改汇总数字；从原始 JSONL 重新计算，检查是否混用了不同实验目录。
fix.en: Do not hand-edit metrics. Recompute from raw JSONL and check for mixed experiment directories.

symptom.zh: 报告只有代码，没有结论
symptom.en: The report has code but no conclusion

fix.zh: 补一句有条件的结论：在什么环境/负载下，改了什么，观察到什么，还有什么不能推断。
fix.en: Add a conditional conclusion stating environment/workload, change, observation and what remains unknown.

question.zh: manifest 哈希能证明数据一定来自 GPU 吗？
question.en: Do manifest hashes prove GPU provenance?

options.zh: 不能，只帮助检查文件内容是否变化
options.en: No, they help detect changed file contents
Only when there are many files

explanation.zh: 真实性还依赖运行记录、环境和可复现性，哈希本身不证明来源。
explanation.en: Provenance requires run records, environment and reproducibility; a hash alone does not establish it.

question.zh: CPU 模拟作品应该怎样写进简历？
question.en: How should a CPU simulation project be described?

options.zh: 实现并验证模拟工具，明确模型假设和局限
options.en: Implemented/validated simulation tools with stated assumptions and limits

options.zh: 虚构一个 GPU 配置

explanation.zh: 真实呈现工具、分析和本人贡献，同样能体现工程能力。
explanation.en: Honest tooling, analysis and personal contribution can demonstrate engineering ability.
